name: Dori
author: infiniV
description: Turn an Android phone into a webcam, a screen you can mirror, and a notification source, over USB or Wi-Fi.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: the phone's camera as a real v4l2 webcam, and its screen mirrored here, both over adb.

schema.label: Live preview of the phone screen
schema.description: Shows a still of the phone's screen beside the controls, refreshed about once a second while the panel is open.

schema.label: Webcam device
schema.description: The v4l2loopback node the camera is streamed into. Must match the one dori-setup made; if you moved it, run `dori-setup --device-number N` with the same number.

schema.label: Back camera id
schema.description: Run `scrcpy --list-cameras` if the back and front buttons are swapped.

schema.label: Back camera rotation
schema.description: Clockwise, for a phone that hands over the back sensor rotated. Set 180 if the picture is upside down. Also on the panel, under CAMERA.

schema.label: Front camera rotation
schema.description: The same, for the front sensor. The two are separate because the two are mounted differently.

schema.label: Camera resolution
schema.description: Longest edge of the captured picture: 1280 is 720p, 1920 is 1080p, 3840 is 4K. Higher costs the phone battery and heat for detail most calls scale away again. Also on the panel, under CAMERA.

schema.label: Camera frame rate
schema.description: Capture rate for the webcam stream. 30 is what video calls use; 60 is for recording something that moves.

schema.label: Typing into the mirror
schema.description: sdk works everywhere. uhid behaves like a real keyboard but types nothing until you set a layout on the phone, under Settings > System > Languages and input > Physical keyboard.

schema.label: Blank the phone screen while mirroring
Hide the bar icon when no phone is attached
